summary.text: Eat Heart is an immortal killer move named when Spectral Soul uses it.

claims.text: Peaceful Soil Heavy Mountain Fortress is heavily damaged. A hole opens to the outside. Through that hole, Giant Spectral Soul’s four eyes look at Fang Yuan sitting inside. Spectral Soul decides to use his trump card. Immortal killer move Eat Heart is named. He says he comprehended this move in his later years from The Legends of Ren Zu, and that the current Peaceful Soil Heavy Mountain Fortress has no way of blocking this attack. Fang Yuan grunts, his face becomes distorted, and he grasps his chest. The intense pain in his heart felt like it was bitten by a fierce beast.

The food path killer move eat heart that Spectral Soul created was a greater creation than bitter taste and swallow loss. Fang Yuan is hit. Spectral Soul’s four eyes stay on Fang Yuan, most of his attention spent on sustaining eat heart.

With eat heart broken, Spectral Soul suffered a backlash. Fang Yuan coughs out blood inside Peaceful Soil Heavy Mountain Fortress. This was the result of Spectral Soul’s eat heart killer move. Peaceful Soil Heavy Mountain Fortress could not fully resist the power of eat heart.

When Spectral Soul used eat heart earlier, many soul path Immortal Gu were destroyed, and he expended a huge amount of food path mortal Gu. He could not use eat heart for the following short period of time. In terms of food path, Spectral Soul only had three killer moves. Eat heart was only used with great difficulty. It was a one-time use trump card.

The most dangerous moment was when Giant Spectral Soul used the killer move eat heart on Fang Yuan. Fang Yuan was truly defenseless at that moment. He had to gamble. He forced himself to laugh and put up a perfect disguise, hoaxing Demon Immortal Qi Jue to attack and betray Spectral Soul. That interrupted eat heart and allowed him to survive.
